deepseek-engy-max.notes: 9Router hits the Engy provider directly. Effort is spelled in parentheses.

haiku-amp-native.notes: Amp's own Claude access, no 9Router and no Devin bridge. Same base as the other Haiku rows.

haiku-anthropic-direct.notes: Retired in favor of haiku-5.5-max/-xhigh, which now own the native Anthropic route for Claude Code. Kept resolvable (empty harnesses) for archived trials.

swe-2-1-max.notes: Devin bridge route for swe-2.1 at max effort, already registered in the host custom-model catalog. Droid-only until another harness proves a route. No pricing row yet: cost reporting returns None until Devin publishes rates.

swe-2-1-xhigh.notes: Devin bridge route for swe-2.1 at xhigh effort, already registered in the host custom-model catalog. Droid-only until another harness proves a route. No pricing row yet: cost reporting returns None until Devin publishes rates.

haiku-5.5-max.notes: Claude Code reaches Haiku 5.5 through its native Anthropic route and the subscription OAuth token, not the Devin bridge (Devin's weekly quota is exhausted).

haiku-5.5-xhigh.notes: Claude Code reaches Haiku 5.5 through its native Anthropic route and the subscription OAuth token; effort goes in via reasoning_effort, not the route id.

gpt-6-luna-max.notes: Amp cannot reach the cx provider ('Unknown model provider: cx' through its OpenAI bridge), so amp is excluded; the run would silently no-op.
